newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong stocks seen volatile, slightly weaker.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks seen volatile, slightly weaker.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks are seen moving in a volatile but narrow band on Thursday due to the expiry of the May index futures contract and retail interest concentrated on newcomer Beijing Enterprises, brokers said.
"With the expiry of futures we will probably be up and down 50 points and could close slightly down on the day," said a broker with a large British house.
"There are still quite a few long positions out there."
Thursday is the last day for trading in the May Hang Seng Index futures contract. The contract swung through a range of almost 200 points on Wednesday.
Overnight, the Hang Seng London Reference Index closed 6.74 points lower at 14,549.74, chiefly on profit-taking in Hang Seng Bank Ltd.

Brokers said the listing of red chip newcomer Beijing Enterprises, which has attracting a phenomenal amount of retail investor interest, could take some heat out of the market and red chips in particular.
